title.zh: Google will buy half the electricity from one of Finland's nuclear power plants
title.en: Google will buy half the electricity from one of Finland's nuclear power plants

current_state.zh: Google signed a 22-year contract with Finnish utility Fortum to buy up to half the output of the Loviisa nuclear power plant, underscoring the scale of data-center electricity demand.
